text:
Type: embossed ceramic planter
Use: holding a small indoor plant; on a shelf, windowsill or side table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: matte glazed ceramic, embossed floral relief, ribbed interior
Colors: soft warm white, light beige interior
Shape: rounded cup shape with gently curved base, all-over medallion flower pattern, small to medium
Feel: soft, light, delicate
Goes with: light wood, rattan, cream and beige textiles; Scandinavian or boho rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medium Floral-Embossed Planter, 6"H, Cloud Dancer White
product.description: This eye-catching planter is the perfect vessel for a plant, flower, or other greenery of your choice, or you can choose to keep it empty or use it to display other items in your home. The white color will look great in any room or outdoor space. 6.7" diameter x 6"H; 6" interior diameter 100% ceramic stoneware This natural stoneware pot is perfect for showing off your favorite flower or plant and includes a drainage hole. With an embossed floral pattern in white glaze, there's no wrong way to display this classic pot. Fill it with your favorite plant or keep it empty. No assembly required Hand wash with a wet cloth.
